final: WITH station_phase AS (SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), moon_phase AS (SELECT moon_phase, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_station_bandwidth_usage, SUM(record_count) AS phase_count FROM station_phase GROUP BY moon_phase), total AS (SELECT SUM(phase_count) AS total_count FROM moon_phase) SELECT m.moon_phase, m.avg_station_bandwidth_usage, m.phase_count, 1.0 * m.phase_count / total.total_count AS count_share FROM moon_phase AS m JOIN total ON total.total_count IS NOT NULL
